name: MET proto-oncogene, receptor tyrosine kinase

function.text: MET encodes the hepatocyte growth factor receptor tyrosine kinase, which regulates proliferation, survival, migration, and tissue-remodeling responses.

germline.text: Retained constitutional disease associations include papillary renal cell carcinoma (autosomal dominant); hereditary papillary renal cell carcinoma (autosomal dominant). Pathogenicity and inheritance depend on the specific allele and disorder.

somatic.text: Reported somatic alteration contexts include Lung adenocarcinoma; Gastric adenocarcinoma; Hepatocellular carcinoma. The alteration class and exact variant must be assessed in the disease context.
